selection_rules.A: Patient with largest segmentation-induced absolute EF error.
selection_rules.B: Misclassified patient with largest frozen classifier confidence score.
selection_rules.C: Patient with largest absolute end-to-end reference-to-predicted EF error.
selection_rules.D: Misclassified patient with smallest distance from reference EF to the nearest 40% or 50% classification boundary. Ties prioritized by larger end-to-end EF error, then patient ID.
selection_rules.E: Correctly classified patient minimizing the sum of ranks for high mean ED/ES Dice, low segmentation-induced EF error, and low end-to-end EF error.

duplicate_policy: If multiple criteria select the same patient, the duplicate is retained and not manually replaced.
